inform.para: The direct view of passenger cabin by cabin attendants pertains to direct visual contact between the cabin attendants and the passenger cabin. The following conditions should not apply to each cabin attendant, but each condition must be ensured by one or several cabin attendants:

item.para: At least two cabin attendants, one at each end of the cabin, must participate in meeting direct view,
At least 80 of the total number of passenger seats installed must be visible to cabin attendants,
At least 50 of the seats in each passenger zone must be visible to cabin attendants.

note.para: A passenger zone is a portion of the passenger cabin that is separated by interior features. These features may be class dividers, galleys, cabin doors or other items that interrupt continuous passenger seating, or line of sight.

item.para: The total length of the main aisle must be visible to cabin attendants,
Cabin doors (or as a minimum, the access from the passenger zone to the cabin door) must be visible to the cabin attendant assigned to the pair of doors.

procitem.title: Procedure to be developed in the Operator's MEL

inform.para: Alternate procedures must be established before departure for displaced cabin attendant(s) according to national regulations.
